Name: reporting_level
Description: Level of reporting (e.g. NSW, Peer group, Local health district [LHD], Hospital)

Name: entity_id
Description: Unique identifier of the healthcare entity

Name: entity_longname
Description: Full name of the healthcare entity

Name: entity_shortname
Description: Short name of the healthcare entity

Name: lhd_shortname
Description: Name of the healthcare entity's local health district (e.g. South Western Sydney, South Eastern Sydney)

Name: peer_group_shortname
Description: Name of the healthcare entity's peer group (e.g. Principal referral)

Name: reporting_category
Description: Breakdown of results at an overall level or by broad categories (i.e. total, MOS, triage, benchmark)

Name: subcategory
Description: Subcategory used for reporting and linked to the reporting category (e.g.  triage category includes T1: Resuscitation, T2: Emergency, T3: Urgent, T4: Semi-Urgent and T5: Non-Urgent)

Name: metric
Description: Data type for a measure_value (e.g. number, percentage, minutes)

Name: note_symbol
Description: Symbol indicating context for interpreting the measure value (see note_text)

Name: note_text
Description: Notes and context to support interpretation of results, attached to the notes symbol

Name: system_change_note
Description: Note explaining any system changes that may have impacted the results

Name: additional_notes
Description: Additional notes and context to support interpretation of results
